answers.sql: WITH x AS (SELECT (SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE period_end='2024-10-27' AND months=3 AND measure='Revenue' AND basis='GAAP') r,(SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE period_end='2024-10-27' AND months=3 AND measure='Gross profit' AND basis='GAAP') g,(SELECT SUM(amount) FROM adjustments WHERE period_end='2024-10-27' AND months=3 AND measure='Gross profit') a) SELECT r-(SELECT midpoint*(1+range_width/100.0) FROM guidance WHERE issue_date='2024-08-28' AND fiscal_period='Q3FY2025' AND measure='Revenue' AND basis='GAAP') FROM x
